translate_en|mods/LootRunAssistant/42/me: If you also run Container Cleanup, loot run mode arms and disarms it alongside the map marks - one key for the whole loot run. Container Cleanup's own key still works on its own. Does nothing if that mod is not installed.

Switch loot run mode on as soon as you load a save or join a server, instead of starting off and waiting for the key. You still get the usual message telling you it is on - and telling you if Container Cleanup has been armed with it, which is worth reading before you start emptying containers.
Erase every mark this character has placed and forget them. Does not touch symbols you drew on the map yourself.

The colour of the mark - the circle, the date, or both, whichever you have switched on. Marks already on your map are repainted to match when you press Apply, so you are not left with two colours. In multiplayer, marks you have already shared keep the colour they were shared in - the server owns those now - but everything you place afterwards uses the new one.

How long you have to stay inside a building before it is marked. Stops a lobby you cut through on the way somewhere else from being marked as looted. Measured in in-game minutes, so it means the same thing at every day length.

Switches loot run mode on and off. While it is on, every building you enter is circled on your world map and dated. Starts off when you load a save or join a server, unless you turn on "Start loot run mode automatically".
Loot Run Assistant could not reach the map - see console.txt
The main job of the mod. Turn this off to keep loot run mode purely as a Container Cleanup switch.
Loot run marking is not allowed on this server
Loot run mode ON - marking buildings (%1 to stop)
Loot run mode ON - marking buildings, cleanup armed (%1 to stop)

Multiplayer only. Every player on the server sees the buildings you have marked. Use this if the two boxes below are not showing your marks to the people you play with - they only reach players who are in the same safehouse or faction as you, which is narrower than it sounds. Overrides both.
Share marks I have already placed

Sharing is decided when a mark goes down, so switching it on above leaves the marks already on your map private. This shares those too. Press Apply first - the button uses your saved settings, not the boxes as they stand.
Multiplayer only. As above, but for players in the same faction. Can be combined with safehouse sharing.

Multiplayer only. Players who are members of the same safehouse as you see the buildings you have marked, and you see theirs. If you are not in a safehouse, or the others are in a different one, this shares with nobody.
No marks to share - check your sharing settings and press Apply

Circle each building you mark. Turn it off to leave just the date on the map - it is drawn larger on its own, since it no longer has to fit inside the ring. With this and the date both off there is nothing to draw, and nothing gets marked.
Show the date on the mark
Write the day and month on the mark - inside the circle if you are drawing one - so you can tell a house you cleared this morning from one you cleared last month.
Do not mark sheds, outhouses and similar. They hold almost nothing and marking them clutters the map.
Let players share their loot run marks with their safehouse or faction. Turn this off to keep every player's marks private to them, whatever they have set client-side.
Master switch. Turn this off to disable loot run mode for everyone on this server. Only applies to players connected to a server running this mod - a client-only install is not affected.
